parsed.answer: The claim is contradicted by the corpus: RANKL signals from CD4+3− inducer cells promote maturation of RANK-expressing CD80−Aire− mTEC progenitors into CD80+Aire+ mTECs, establishing a direct RANK-RANKL role in Aire+ mTEC generation. A second study confirms RANK signaling is essential for mTEC development (required during embryogenesis, cooperating with CD40 postnatally) to establish self-tolerance.
